ruleDefinitions.name: AWS EC2 VM Export Failure
ruleDefinitions.description: An attempt to export an AWS EC2 instance has been detected. A VM Export might indicate an attempt to extract information from an instance. Note: Unmapped fields: eventName, eventSource, errorMessage, errorCode, responseElements

sequences.query: (eventName = "CreateInstanceExportTask" AND eventSource = "ec2\.amazonaws\.com") AND  NOT (errorMessage = RGX(".**.*") OR errorCode = RGX(".**.*") OR responseElements = RGX(".*Failure.*"))
